title: Effects of Royal Jelly Administration on Endurance Training-Induced Mitochondrial Adaptations in Skeletal Muscle
authors: Yumiko Takahashi, Kamiyu Hijikata, Kohei Seike, Suguru Nakano, Mai Banjo, Yosuke Sato, Kenya Takahas...
abstract: Royal jelly was administered to mice undergoing endurance training to study its effects on muscle mitochondria. Royal jelly enhanced training-induced mitochondrial adaptations in soleus muscles by activating AMPK.
